conditions: Saturday evening, 34°C and dry, gusty north wind blowing toward the Food Court. Headliner on Main Stage 21:00 to 22:30; the crowd surges forward when they start and out through Gate A when they finish.

main-stage.name: Main Stage
main-stage.notes: Two extinguishers behind the sound desk, one in the stage-left wing. Exit A (north, to Gate A) and Exit B (east, to the Food Court). Crowd is densest centre-front at the barrier. The stage manager can pause the show.

food-court.name: Food Court
food-court.notes: Eight food trucks cooking on gas; each has a gas shut-off at the rear, an extinguisher and a fire blanket. The walkway between trucks is narrow and jams at peak times. Water station at the east end.

gate-a.name: Gate A
gate-a.notes: Main entry and exit with a security checkpoint. Ambulance lane on the left side, keep it clear. Bottleneck when the headliner finishes.

first-aid-tent.name: First Aid Tent
first-aid-tent.notes: Two paramedics on duty, an AED, shade and cooling. Stretcher access from the service road behind the tent.
